chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Mufaddal ibn Salih al-Asadi, from Muhammad ibn Harun, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When one of you prays and does not mention the Prophet and his Progeny (peace be upon them) in his prayer, his prayer is taken by a path other than the way to Paradise.
And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'He in whose presence I am mentioned and does not send blessings upon me, will enter the Fire, so Allah will distance him.'
And he (peace be upon him) said: 'And he in whose presence I am mentioned and forgets to send blessings upon me, he is made to err on the path to Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of not mentioning the Prophet and his family during prayer?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith to underscore the theological necessity of including Salawāt upon the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt within the prayer itself, not merely as a post-prayer supplication. The narration distinguishes between the consequences of omission and forgetfulness, with deliberate neglect leading to the Fire and accidental omission causing one to stray from the direct path to Paradise, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the spiritual intercession of the Prophet's Household.
